As I navigated through the rush, my phone slid out of my bag and landed on the floor, drawing a small crowd. People around me mumbled and shifted, a collective discomfort evident in their expressions. It was then that I noticed a young woman with a determined look in her eyes, her phone clutched tightly in her hand, standing behind a tall gentleman who seemed to be blocking the path to the lost device.
